units.source_text: 到了十月里，紫夫人为源氏祝寿，在嵯峨野的佛堂里举办药师佛供养。

en.t: In the tenth month, Lady Murasaki celebrated Genji's longevity by holding a Yakushi Buddha offering in a Buddhist hall at Sagano.

units.source_text: 因为源氏恳切劝诫她不可过分铺张，所以一切布置都秘密进行。

en.t: Because Genji had earnestly warned her not to be too extravagant, all the preparations were carried out in secret.

units.source_text: 然而也很体面，佛像、经盒和包经卷的竹箦都极精美，

en.t: Even so, the ceremony was very dignified, and the Buddhist images, sutra boxes, and even the bamboo mats used to wrap the scrolls were exquisitely made,

units.source_text: 使人走进佛堂，似觉真个到了西方极乐世界。

en.t: so that anyone entering the hall felt as if they had truly arrived in the Western Pure Land.

units.source_text: 所诵的是《最胜王经》《金刚般若经》和《寿命经》，规模甚大。

en.t: The sutras recited were the Sutra of the Golden Light, the Diamond Prajnaparamita Sutra, and the Sutra of Longevity, and the scale of the rite was very grand.

units.source_text: 满朝公卿王侯都来参与祈祷，半是为了这佛堂的景象美不可言，

en.t: All the nobles and princes of the court came to join the prayers, partly because the scene at the Buddhist hall was beautiful beyond words,

units.source_text: 从穿过红叶林、走进嵯峨野开始，一路上都是美丽的秋景，

en.t: and from the moment they passed through the groves of crimson leaves and entered Sagano, the whole road was filled with lovely autumn scenery,
so everyone vied with one another to attend.

units.source_text: 满目霜华的原野上，车马之声络绎不绝。

en.t: Across the fields glittering everywhere with frost, the sounds of carriages and horses went on without pause.

units.source_text: 诸位夫人争先恐后地致送精美物品，以供布施诵经僧众。

en.t: The ladies, too, competed to send beautiful gifts as offerings for the monks who were reciting the sutras.
